selection: Three named NLP abstracts for a field profile; three named abstracts for editing, including SQuAD recovered from its reviewed PDF page 1 after XML absence. Three additional W19 abstracts chosen after searching for real framing/hedge examples. Two complete Chinese HC3 answers reused from the earlier evaluation. Convenience/development application set, not a held-out benchmark.
profile_scope: Multi-author NLP-abstract field profile; not a personal-author profile.
generation: Current conversational assistant reads ClearWeave 0.3.0, applies it once with a targeted self-review. No independent model API or human judge. Scripts perform checks and measurements, not generation.
task_en: Copyedit this published abstract using ClearWeave. Preserve facts, author positions, numerical estimates, uncertainty, citation strings and technical terms. Correct evident grammar and redundant framing; allow no change when appropriate. Use the three-reference NLP field profile only as descriptive context, never copy its facts. Return clean prose and separate brief edit notes.
task_zh: 按 ClearWeave 润色这条历史中文回答，保留原文立场、事实、数字、条件和不确定性，压缩重复表述。只做编辑，不替它回答问题或更新知识。
known_exposure: Sentence-BERT inspected before narrow grammar rules were written. HC3 records used in v0.2.0. Host pretraining exposure unknown.

inference_metadata.generation_method: assistant-authored revisions under loaded skill instructions

snapshot_stage: Final runtime fingerprint after the recorded targeted self-review; no further rules tuned to these outputs.
source_recovery: D16-1264 XML has no abstract; same-paper PDF excerpt in the main-branch data-integrity update was visually checked on page 1 and retained as an unchanged control. The absence and recovery are recorded; no replacement paper was selected.
